desc: In veneration of Lord Venkateswara, devotees and priests listen to devotional songs and perform religious customs in order to seek his blessings.

title: Sri Vishnu Sahasranama Stotram
desc: Devotees recite the Sri Vishnu Sahasranama Stotram, in the name of Lord Vishnu to seek blessings and lead a better prosperous life..

title: Sai Sahasranamam
desc: Religious leaders chant the Sai Sahasranamam, a devotional hymn comprising a thousand revered names of Sai Baba of Shirdi, to invoke his blessings and divine grace.

title: Sai Manthtram
desc: Religious speakers recite mantras in continuous praise of Sai Baba of Shirdi, inspiring devotees to embrace a life of righteousness and spiritual devotion.

title: Sai Namalu
desc: A religious scholar chants devotional hymns in praise of Sai Baba and sheds light on the miraculous acts performed by Him for the devotees.

title: Dakshinamurthy Abhisekam
desc: Hindu priests perform sacred ceremonial rituals as an act of worship and devotion to Lord Dakshinamurti, seeking divine blessings for a fulfilled life.

title: Yadadri Abhishekam
desc: Religious leaders and devotees chant sacred prayers and hymns while performing a ritual to seek blessings from the Almighty.

title: Sastra Vachanam
desc: The host engages in conversation with a religious personality and discusses Hindu scriptures in a detailed manner with suitable examples.

title: Commercial
desc: The host shares information about a wide selection of products that can be purchased from the comfort of the consumer's home.
